limitations.title: Shared buffers are not hardware coherent
limitations.impact: Stale reads or loss of dirty data across CPU/DMA ownership changes.
limitations.trigger: Concurrent cached CPU access and non-snooping DMA/LP access.
limitations.workaround: Use exclusive ownership, whole cache-block ranges, directional cache maintenance and fences.
limitations.applies_to: Reviewed v0.4 PRODUCT snapshot; MPW differences are stated separately.

limitations.title: HP loader has no firmware-local ready timeout
limitations.impact: LP can wait indefinitely for the expected Linux mailbox event.
limitations.trigger: No mailbox message after HP release.
limitations.workaround: Use the simulator deadline during acceptance. A board supervisor/watchdog policy is integration work; no automatic retry is implemented here.
limitations.applies_to: Reviewed v0.4 PRODUCT snapshot; MPW differences are stated separately.

limitations.title: Boot CRC is not authentication
limitations.impact: A CRC-valid image is not proven to come from a trusted signer.
limitations.trigger: Untrusted image or writable external boot storage.
limitations.workaround: Treat signing, key storage, rollback prevention and secure recovery as separate unimplemented system requirements.
limitations.applies_to: Reviewed v0.4 PRODUCT snapshot; MPW differences are stated separately.

limitations.title: Native Linux peripheral coverage is incomplete
limitations.impact: A HAL or DT node does not provide a native Linux driver.
limitations.trigger: Applications attempt direct Linux use of a custom peripheral.
limitations.workaround: Use the published support matrix, retain LP ownership where needed, and validate a platform driver before handoff.
limitations.applies_to: Reviewed v0.4 PRODUCT snapshot; MPW differences are stated separately.

limitations.title: Resource reset request is not universal engine reset
limitations.impact: Some downstream peripheral engines are not reset by the central lifecycle request.
limitations.trigger: Using Resource CONTROL.RESET as independent engine reset containment.
limitations.workaround: Drain and use each IP reset/recovery contract. APU P1 has a local reset connection; do not generalize it to all engines.
limitations.applies_to: Reviewed v0.4 PRODUCT snapshot; MPW differences are stated separately.

limitations.title: Forced HP reset can discard dirty cache state
limitations.impact: Missing cache-clean acknowledgement prevents preservation of modified shared data.
limitations.trigger: HP shutdown times out before acknowledgement.
limitations.workaround: Keep a recoverable authoritative copy outside dirty HP cache; treat timed-out work as failed and reinitialize dependent queues.
limitations.applies_to: Reviewed v0.4 PRODUCT snapshot; MPW differences are stated separately.

limitations.title: QPI and OPI cannot operate together
limitations.impact: The inactive memory window returns an error and its pads are disconnected.
limitations.trigger: Accessing the inactive memory mode or attempting a live protocol change.
limitations.workaround: Select the mode at boot before use; respect the sticky lock. A live handover is not supported.
limitations.applies_to: Reviewed v0.4 PRODUCT snapshot; MPW differences are stated separately.

limitations.title: Generic FPGA routes do not qualify every interface
limitations.impact: Dedicated USB2 ULPI and SDIO1 pads need board assignment and electrical/timing review.
limitations.trigger: Assuming logical pads are FPGA ball or package-pin assignments.
limitations.workaround: Supply board constraints, bank voltages, external devices and validated timing before enabling a physical route.
limitations.applies_to: Reviewed v0.4 PRODUCT snapshot; MPW differences are stated separately.

limitations.title: APU production codec jobs remain disabled
limitations.impact: The register shell and bounded codec/transport work do not establish a complete media product.
limitations.trigger: Submitting unsupported production codec or KWS jobs.
limitations.workaround: Check the implemented capability and job result; use only the bounded supported path described in the APU chapter.
limitations.applies_to: Reviewed v0.4 PRODUCT snapshot; MPW differences are stated separately.

limitations.title: Integrated RNG entropy is unqualified
limitations.impact: Deterministic test data cannot supply production cryptographic entropy.
limitations.trigger: Using the current entropy stream to generate secret keys or nonces.
limitations.workaround: Keep diagnostic use separate; production entropy requires a reviewed physical source and qualification.
limitations.applies_to: Reviewed v0.4 PRODUCT snapshot; MPW differences are stated separately.

limitations.title: Physical operating limits are not characterized
limitations.impact: Configuration clocks and behavioral models are not electrical or silicon ratings.
limitations.trigger: Selecting board voltage, frequency, thermal or timing limits from RTL defaults.
limitations.workaround: Use approved technology, macro, package and board reports; leave absent specifications TBD.
limitations.applies_to: Reviewed v0.4 PRODUCT snapshot; MPW differences are stated separately.

limitations.title: Legacy PRODUCT window is not an MPW selector
limitations.impact: Legacy selection writes are rejected in PRODUCT.
limitations.trigger: Calling selectable user-core/IP mutators on a fixed PRODUCT configuration.
limitations.workaround: Detect mode/capabilities first and use fixed EXT-L/EXT-H APIs in PRODUCT.
limitations.applies_to: Reviewed v0.4 PRODUCT snapshot; MPW differences are stated separately.

limitations.title: Native JPEG master has no normal admission credits
limitations.impact: The dedicated JPEG AXI path is wired to data-master slot 6, but the current crossbar read/write credit functions return zero for that slot. Normal payload addresses cannot be admitted through that route.
limitations.trigger: JPEG private-master traffic routed through the reviewed PRODUCT data plane.
limitations.workaround: Treat end-to-end JPEG private-DMA operation as unavailable on this snapshot. Standalone codec behavior does not prove SoC integration. A separately reviewed RTL change and regression are required; this publication does not change hardware.
limitations.applies_to: Reviewed PRODUCT source snapshot; static implementation finding, not silicon measurement.

conflicts.condition: Select one memory-pad mode at boot; the inactive aperture returns an error.
Convenience clients cannot overwrite an in-flight shared context. XPI accepts a caller-selected channel; changing it still requires ownership and endpoint checks.
DMA rejects another active channel targeting the same protected stream endpoint. A different channel number alone does not permit concurrent ownership.
Check the APU/I2S stream-switch selection. No simultaneous competing TX producers or RX consumers are implied. Production APU jobs remain disabled.

conflicts.resource: I/O gateway A and resource blocking
conflicts.condition: These private masters share a gateway; ownership and lifecycle gates can conservatively block related traffic.
Separate controllers still share the admission path and memory targets.
Use the generated GPIO ALT0/ALT1 matrix. A pin has one selected output/enable owner; different functions in one row cannot be enabled independently.
Stop affected transfers before changing their source/divider. Recompute rates after the transition; stable audio/memory domains have separate rules.
Allowed routes are not a simultaneous throughput guarantee. Native JPEG slot 6 currently has zero master credits; see the bus table.
